scores.reasons: Gap: no GBP, obfuscated contact details, broken mobile, no schema — nearly everything a local AI search needs is missing. Ability: solo appraiser on a template site; appraisal fees are modest and budget likely tight. Ease: GBP plus a simple responsive rebuild is a short engagement. Evidence: site, order path and Maps results inspected; address conflict unresolved.

caveats: Google ratings are as displayed on the Maps panel at the time of check; review counts were not rendered in the panel view for most listings, so counts are marked unknown rather than estimated.

Several businesses in this batch are professional-services firms (engineering, architecture, appraisal, title) whose customers rarely book online; 'bookable' scores reflect the absence of any request/quote path an agent could complete, not a failure to offer consumer-style booking.
MDM Architecture's website failure was reproduced with two independent HTTP clients but the cause (expired certificate vs. server misconfiguration) could not be determined from outside.
data_gaps: Google review counts could not be read for any listing (the panel shows a rating but no count element in this view).
Paragon Staffing's site returns HTTP 403 to non-browser fetchers; content was read in Chrome instead, and its robots.txt is generated by Cloudflare.
Salem Engineering's street address in North Brunswick is not published on its website; batch.json also had no address, so only the city/ZIP and phone could be confirmed.
Mundra Appraisals' address is inconsistent between the website footer (Somerset, NJ) and directory listings (525 Milltown Rd, North Brunswick); the practice's current location is unverified.
No Google Business Profile could be found for Mundra Appraisals; it may exist under a different name or be unclaimed and unindexed.
Strategy Staff's Google review count and Mundra's third-party directory details were not opened directly where noted; those figures come from search-result summaries.
